facebook.text:
Foreign Ownership of Condominiums in Thailand

Foreign buyers can own a condominium unit in Thailand in their own name, which is why most foreign purchases in Phuket are condos. Here are the main rules, in plain language.

In the guide:
• The 49% foreign quota
• Funds must come from abroad
• What you receive
• Checks before you reserve
• Off-plan and ready units

Read it: https://estate.nightdestiny.com/guides/foreign-ownership-condo-thailand/

General information only, not legal or tax advice, and rules can change. Confirm every point with a licensed Thai lawyer and the Land Department before you pay a deposit.
